question: Can the image generator displace material and aesthetic language radically while preserving the body-plan distinctions carried by five three-reference armatures?
visualFindings: At seed 718113, all five green-purple fleshy baseline organisms become pale cracked ceramic-mineral/fungal organisms with cyan seams while retaining recognizable silhouette, mass distribution, and contact pattern.
At seed 718211, the same material basin reproduces across all five bodies and the program-level morphology distinctions remain legible.
Crawler, three upright variants, and long-necked bulbous radial form remain mutually distinct after style displacement.
In several cells the explicit material prompt also improves adherence to the source armature relative to the baseline invention prompt.

claimBoundary.supported: Within this five-body, two-seed assay, body-plan conditioning and one radically displaced material/aesthetic instruction are independently steerable enough to compose.

nextPressure: Widen silhouette and gestalt variation inside source-anchored 3D programs, then test region-localized semantic handles rather than spending the next slice on another global style prompt.
